scope.summary: Add the Color Grading group: independent Shadows/Midtones/Highlights color wheels (hue + saturation per range, per-range luminance slider); a global color wheel; and Blending + Balance controls governing range overlap/weight. It MUST subsume the split-toning capability of [STU-RAW-006] as its two-range degenerate case, not a separate primitive.
expected_tests: test: 3-range + global wheels + blend/balance evaluate; split-toning reproduced as two-range degenerate case
acceptance_criteria_original: 3-range + global grading wheels; split-toning subsumed; Argus + manual

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Color Grading

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAW-008]** The Colour Grading group MUST provide independent shadow, midtone and highlight wheels (hue and saturation per range with a per-range luminance), a global wheel, and blending and balance controls. It subsumes split toning as its two-range degenerate case. Contract in [STU-RAW-116].

**[STU-RAW-006]** The Tone Curve group MUST provide a parametric curve with region sliders and adjustable split points, a point curve on the composite channel, and independent red, green and blue point curves. Contracts in [STU-RAW-112] and [STU-RAW-113].

**[STU-RAW-018]** Every `StudioRawDevelop` control group, mask source, enhance operation, profile and preset action, and workflow option MUST be exposed as a typed, model-steerable command with a stable identifier and MUST be observable through the Studio visual-debug/inspection surface (Argus) per 14.16; all raw develop operations MUST run headless and quiet under 14.20 (no foreground window, no focus steal, bounded and observable); and each MUST carry a dual-audience UserManual entry per 14.22 covering purpose, inputs and outputs, and failure and recovery. A model-authored develop edit MUST pass the sandbox → `StudioValidationDescriptor` → `PromotionGate` lifecycle of [STU-ARC-005] before it changes authority rows; model confidence never bypasses the gate.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
